text_block_list.name: Yamato
text_block_list.text: Those small fries are so annoying, scurrying all around!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ったくザコどもがチョロチョロと、
鬱陶しいねぇ！

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text:
Small fry for small fry~
Here, boom.
Sacrificial Bakana for you~♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
ザコにはザコを
ってことで～
はいっ、
どーん。
生贄バカナだよ～ん♡

text_block_list.name: Wakana
text_block_list.orig_text:
うひゃあぁぁ！
フ、
フブキちゃん！？

text_block_list.name: Yamato
text_block_list.text:
Good, the enemy formation is breaking!
──Now's the time!
text_block_list.orig_text:
よし、
敵陣が崩れた！
──今だよ！
